Fig S1. Scanning electron micrograph (SEM) of FWPC.  
Fig. S1 shows an SEM image of the FWPC sample. There were ~1 -μm macropores and a 
few micropores on the FWPC that were not handled by the gelation process. Additionally, 
the connectivity of the FWPC was poor, the pore -size distribution was not uniform, and the 
hole wall was thick.
